title: Intelligence Network: open data
description: A citizen sensor network's readings, events and storms. People appear only as handles with a ZIP and county.

readings.description: One row per reading: people's (sensor = an s-xxxxx handle; ZIP5 and county only, no coordinates) and official NWS storm reports (exact points). Values are in the metric's canonical unit (see metrics). quality: raw, corroborated, flagged, rejected, reference.

events.description: Readings past a threshold, per county and metric. Places are ZIP or county centres.

storms.description: Events and storm-based warnings clustered per storm, with the network's brief.

alerts.description: NWS alerts the network tracked (one row per alert, all its updates folded in).

sensors.description: Who reported: people as handles with a home county; official sources by id.

metrics.description: The common data language: every metric's key, label and canonical unit.
